checks.name: exact_title
checks.details: The HTML title and h1 use the exact publication title, including the DELIVER randomized clinical trial subtitle.

checks.name: coverage_manifest
checks.details: Primary article, source sections, main-text visuals, and both supplements are explicitly inventoried with coverage decisions.

checks.name: section_condensation
checks.details: Introduction/background, methods, results, discussion/conclusion, and limitations are represented.

checks.name: main_text_visual_reconciliation
checks.details: Table 1, Table 2, Figure 1, Figure 2, and Table 3 are reconciled as structured representations.

checks.name: ratings_contract
checks.details: All 6 ratings contain a score, rationale, evidence basis, principal limiting factor, and what would raise/lower the score.

checks.name: toc_anchor_resolution
checks.details: TOC targets metadata, coverage, synthesis, sections, visuals, appraisal, takeaways, and provenance are present as section ids.

checks.name: no_internal_citation_syntax
checks.details: No internal ChatGPT/file-search citation marker is present in the persisted HTML.

checks.name: no_placeholders_or_planning_language
checks.details: No TODO marker was found; the artifact contains completed analytical prose rather than execution planning.

checks.name: provenance_and_scope
checks.details: DOI, PMID, PMCID, evaluated Drive primary, generation date, supplement-access limitation, and parent-packet citation-processing boundary are explicit.

limitations: Supplement 1 and Supplement 2 exist and their identities/contents were independently confirmed, but their Drive binaries could not be directly text-extracted through the connector. Inaccessible supplemental material was not converted into unsupported findings.
